This margin compression occurs alongside a trailing price-to-earnings ratio of 26.5x [E1], which climbs to an even more demanding 82.55x according to key-ratios data [E6]. Furthermore, income-seeking investors find zero support from the company, as the dividend yield sits strictly at 0.00% [E4]. The market price is also weighed down by technical weakness, sitting only 25% of the way up its 52-week range between a low of 37 and a high of 102 [E5]. Conceded: the company demonstrates a multi-year margin expansion with operating margins rising to 6% in Mar 2026 compared to -8% three years prior [E30], and a reverse DCF indicating that the current price implies an earnings growth rate of 12.6% which is lower than the 15.0% base case [E48].
